data.description: Discover 12 exclusive villas in District 15 of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), meticulously developed by Iman Developers.

data.answer:
Oxford Villas Dubai community is a thoughtfully designed residential enclave that embodies comfort, luxury, and tranquility—values at the core of its developer’s vision. Each villa is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, featuring internationally acclaimed finishes, high-quality fittings, and premium appliances.

This community offers residents a well-connected lifestyle with seamless access to key areas of Dubai. Its strategic location ensures proximity to essential amenities, making it an ideal choice for families and professionals seeking a refined living experience in a vibrant neighborhood.

Oxford Villas JVC features three distinct villa layouts, each thoughtfully designed to maximize space and comfort. Type A villas span 3,621 sq. ft., Type B covers 3,343 sq. ft., and Type C, the largest, offers 3,543 sq. ft. of covered space. Each residence is spread across three levels, with a well-appointed ground floor that includes a private garden, a parking garage, a spacious living and dining area, a modern kitchen, and a maid’s room with an attached bath. 

The first floor houses two bedrooms with built-in wardrobes, en-suite bathrooms, and a large terrace, while the second floor features two additional bedrooms, including the master suite, both with en-suites and private balconies. These well-planned layouts enhance Oxford Villas Dubai lifestyle, offering a balance of elegance and functionality.

Currently, all villas in Oxford Villas Dubai community are completed and ready for occupancy, making it an excellent choice for those looking to move in immediately. While there are no off-plan developments at the moment, Iman Developers are known for their commitment to quality, and prospective buyers can explore other premium off-plan projects in JVC with similar luxury standards.

Renting a Property in Oxford Villas, JVC

With its high-end features and prime location, Oxford Villas JVC offers a desirable rental option for families and professionals. The spacious villas, premium Oxford Villas Dubai amenities, and proximity to major roads such as Al Khail Road (E44) make this community an attractive choice for those seeking a comfortable and well-connected living environment.

Buying a Property in Oxford Villas

Investing in Oxford Villas Dubai lifestyle presents an opportunity to own a high-quality villa in one of JVC’s most exclusive communities. These properties offer a strong return on investment due to their premium construction, spacious layouts, and sought-after location. With well-designed living spaces and access to key amenities, Oxford Villas JVC is an excellent choice for homebuyers looking for luxury, comfort, and convenience in Dubai.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Oxford Villas?

data.answer:
Oxford Villas Dubai lifestyle offers a perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience, with spacious residences, premium amenities, and a peaceful community atmosphere ideal for families and professionals alike.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Oxford Villas

Each villa in Oxford Villas JVC Dubai features a dedicated parking garage that accommodates up to two cars, ensuring convenience for residents. Visitors and guests can utilize the available street parking beside the villas. The well-planned infrastructure enhances the ease of living, making it a desirable choice for families and professionals.

The Oxford Villas Dubai location offers excellent connectivity to major roads, including Al Khail Road (E44) and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), allowing seamless access to different parts of the city. Public transportation options are also easily accessible, with multiple bus stops such as JVC, Season Community Autumn, JVC, Samer Park, and JVC, Westar La Residencia within a 10-minute drive.

For metro connectivity, Dubai Internet City Metro Station on the Red Line is just an 11-minute drive away, providing quick access to key business and entertainment hubs. Additionally, residents can reach the Dubai Tram network, including Dubai Tram Depot, Knowledge Village Tram Stop, and Al Sufouh Tram Stop, within 14 minutes by car, further enhancing the accessibility of Oxford Villas JVC Dubai.

Supermarkets Around Oxford Villas

Residents of the community have easy access to a variety of grocery stores and supermarkets, ensuring daily essentials are always within reach. Among the Oxford Villas Dubai amenities, convenience is a top priority, with several supermarkets located just a short drive away.

Nearby options include Grandiose Supermarket, Greens Supermarket, Best Home Market, Cart Supermarket JVC, Aswaaq Mart - Sydney Tower JVC, West Zone Fresh Supermarket, and VIVA Supermarket JVC. These well-stocked stores cater to diverse shopping needs and are accessible within a 4 to 6-minute drive, making everyday grocery shopping effortless for residents of Oxford Villas Dubai.

Shopping Malls Near Oxford Villas

For shopping and retail therapy, residents of Oxford Villas Dubai have convenient access to several malls offering a wide range of retail, dining, and entertainment options.

The closest option is The Circle Mall, located in District 11, JVC, just a 7-minute drive away. Developed by Nakheel, this vibrant shopping destination features 235 stores, a Spinneys supermarket, and various entertainment facilities, including a multi-screen cinema, a branch of Faby Land, a rooftop pool, and a sports complex.

For more extensive shopping experiences, Springs Souk and City Centre Me’aisem are both reachable within 14 minutes. Springs Souk, situated in Springs 7, offers over 100 retail outlets, a Carrefour Supermarket, dining options, and Reel Cinemas. 

Meanwhile, City Centre Me’aisem, inaugurated in 2015 in Dubai Production City (IMPZ), boasts numerous retail stores, a Carrefour Hypermarket, Magic Planet, and a variety of restaurants and cafés, ensuring a well-rounded shopping experience for residents of Oxford Villas Dubai.

Schools and Nurseries Near Oxford Villas

Families residing in Oxford Villas Dubai have access to some of the best nurseries and schools, ensuring quality education for children of all ages. Parents can choose from reputable nurseries located just minutes away, such as Chubby Cheeks Nursery and Kids World Nursery JVC. Chubby Cheeks Nursery, situated in Park View Tower, Jumeirah Village Triangle, follows the Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS) framework and caters to children aged 45 days to 4 years old. Kids World Nursery, located in Autumn 2, Seasons Community, offers a Montessori-based curriculum for children aged 1 to 6 years, providing a strong foundation for early learning.

For older children, Oxford Villas Dubai schools include top-rated institutions such as JSS International School, GEMS World Academy, and Sunmarke School. JSS International School follows the Indian Certificate of Secondary Education (ICSE) curriculum and provides education from Kindergarten to Grade 12. It is a well-established private co-educational school known for its strong academic standards.

Another excellent option is GEMS World Academy, managed by GEMS Education, which follows the International Baccalaureate (IB) curriculum from Kindergarten-1 to Grade 12. Located in Al Barsha South, it is just an 11-minute drive from Oxford Villas Dubai schools, making it a convenient choice for families seeking a globally recognized education system.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Oxford Villas

Residents of Oxford Villas JVC Dubai have access to several places of worship catering to different faiths. Muslims can perform their daily prayers at nearby mosques, including Saleh Mohammed Bin Lahej Mosque, Masjid Fatma Al Sayed Mohammad Yousuf Sharaf, Abdullah Mohammad AlShirawi Mosque, and Masjid JVC. These mosques are conveniently located within a 5 to 8-minute drive, offering a peaceful space for worship and community gatherings.

For Christian residents, Fellowship: A Christian Church is just a 14-minute drive away. Additionally, those belonging to other faiths can visit Guru Nanak Darbar Gurdwara and the Hindu temple in Jebel Ali, both accessible within a 20-minute drive. These places provide a welcoming environment for spiritual practice and community engagement, ensuring that residents of Oxford Villas JVC Dubai have convenient options for religious observance.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Oxford Villas

Residents of Oxford Villas Dubai community have access to top healthcare facilities, ensuring quality medical care just minutes from home. Several clinics and hospitals are located nearby, offering specialized treatments across multiple medical fields.

Among the key Oxford Villas Dubai amenities is Aster Clinic JVC, a well-known healthcare provider offering services in general medicine, gynecology, and various other specialties. Located at Damac Tower 108 Street, it is just a 3-minute drive away. Another nearby option is French Care Clinic, situated at Spica Residence in JVC, providing a range of medical services with a focus on personalized care.

For more specialized treatments, Karama Medical Centre offers expert care in ENT, dermatology, gynecology, orthopedics, and general medicine. Additionally, residents can access a variety of other clinics and hospitals in neighboring communities, ensuring comprehensive healthcare solutions close to Oxford Villas Dubai.

Location & Nearby Areas

Oxford Villas Dubai location is surrounded by a mix of townhouses, villas, and apartment buildings, providing a well-integrated residential setting in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). The community enjoys close proximity to several well-established sub-communities, including District 10, District 18, District 14, and Nakheel Villas.

District 10 is primarily a villa community, offering spacious homes in a serene environment. District 18 is an emerging area with several under-construction apartment buildings, while District 14 features a diverse mix of villas, townhouses, and apartments, catering to different residential preferences. 

At the heart of JVC, Nakheel Villas offers a selection of well-designed 2 to 4-bedroom villas, making it a desirable neighborhood for families seeking a balanced lifestyle close to Oxford Villas Dubai.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Oxford Villas, JVC

data.answer:
Residents of Oxford Villas JVC can enjoy a vibrant lifestyle with nearby parks, fitness centers, and leisure spots, along with easy access to The Circle Mall for shopping, dining, and entertainment.

Restaurants

Among the many Oxford Villas Dubai amenities, residents can enjoy a diverse culinary experience with a variety of restaurants just minutes away. Whether craving Indian, Arabic, or Turkish cuisine, there are plenty of options to satisfy every palate. Golden Plates Restaurant, located in Seasons Autumn 2 Block B, specializes in Indian and Chinese dishes, with biryani and kebabs being local favorites. 

Teeneh Ow Zeytoneh, situated in District 10, serves authentic Arabic flavors, while Pide Keyfi, a popular Turkish restaurant in District 13, offers indoor and outdoor seating along with takeout and home delivery services.

For those seeking fine dining and nightlife experiences, residents can venture outside the community to discover upscale restaurants and lounges. Toshi, located at Grand Millennium Dubai in Barsha Heights, is renowned for its Indonesian cuisine and also offers a variety of Japanese, Thai, and Malaysian dishes. 

Olea, situated in the Kempinski Hotel Mall of the Emirates, specializes in authentic Lebanese flavors, while Buddha Bar, an iconic destination in Grosvenor House, Dubai Marina, serves exquisite Thai cuisine in a luxurious setting. Toshi and Olea are within a 15-minute drive, while Buddha Bar is accessible within 18 minutes, making Oxford Villas Dubai amenities ideal for those who appreciate world-class dining experiences.

Beaches Near Oxford Villas

Residents of Oxford Villas Dubai can enjoy a mix of serene and lively beach experiences within a short drive from the community. The nearest option, Al Sufouh Beach, also known as the ‘Secret Beach,’ is just 13 minutes away. This hidden gem offers a peaceful retreat, making it an ideal spot for relaxation away from the city’s hustle.

For those seeking a more vibrant atmosphere, JBR Beach and Kite Beach are accessible within 18 minutes. These popular beaches feature a range of water sports, beachfront dining, and leisure facilities. At JBR Beach, visitors can also enjoy family-friendly attractions such as Roxy Cinemas, Splash Pad, the Flying Cup, and Fun Fair, making it a perfect weekend destination for both adventure and entertainment.

Hotels Around Oxford Villas

Residents and visitors of Oxford Villas Dubai have access to several premium hotels offering luxury stays, fine dining, and top-tier hospitality services. Whether for a weekend getaway or accommodating guests, the nearby hotels provide a variety of options.

  • Five Jumeirah Village – A stylish hotel located in JVC, featuring modern rooms, rooftop pools, gourmet restaurants, and a vibrant nightlife scene.
  • Millennium Mont Rose Executive Apartments – A contemporary hotel in Dubai Science Park, just a short drive away, offering serviced apartments for long and short stays.
  • Grand Millennium Dubai – Situated in Barsha Heights, this five-star hotel offers spacious rooms, an array of international dining options, and a luxury spa.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

The Oxford Villas Dubai lifestyle promotes health and well-being with access to numerous parks, jogging tracks, and fitness centers within Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). Residents can enjoy outdoor activities in Gadaf Park, Sabar Park, and various community parks, which offer green spaces ideal for walking, cycling, and jogging. The community also features well-equipped gyms, swimming pools, and health centers, ensuring a well-rounded fitness routine.

Among the top fitness centers in the area are Fitness 101 at DAMAC Tower 108 and New Life Fitness Gym at Prime Business Centre Tower B, both offering state-of-the-art facilities and boot camps. Yoga enthusiasts can visit Planyyoga Centre, also in Prime Business Centre Tower B, to engage in holistic wellness practices.

For relaxation and self-care, residents have access to top beauty salons and spas within the community. Popular options include Better Beauty Salon, The Urban Cottage, and Creative Touch Beauty Salon, where a range of rejuvenating treatments are available. With these Oxford Villas Dubai amenities, residents can maintain a healthy and balanced lifestyle while enjoying the convenience of nearby wellness services.

Community Events

The Oxford Villas Dubai lifestyle fosters a strong sense of community, with various platforms available for residents to stay informed and connected. Those living in Oxford Villas JVC can keep up with upcoming events, announcements, and neighborhood updates by visiting JVC’s official website.

Additionally, residents can engage with the community through dedicated Facebook groups such as Jumeirah Village Circle, Jumeirah Village Circle – Residents, and Jumeirah Village Circle Community. 

For pet owners, the Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) Pet Owners group provides a space to connect with fellow residents, share experiences, and find pet-friendly services within the area. These social channels enhance community interaction, ensuring that Oxford Villas Dubai residents stay well-informed and actively involved in their neighborhood.

Attractions and Landmarks

The Oxford Villas Dubai location offers seamless connectivity to some of the city's most notable landmarks, thanks to its proximity to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), Al Khail Road (E44), and Hessa Street (D61). These major roadways make it easy for residents to explore Dubai’s top destinations within minutes.

Among the Oxford Villas Dubai nearby attractions is Dubai Autodrome, located just 15 minutes away in Motor City. This premier motorsports venue is perfect for adrenaline enthusiasts, offering thrilling driving experiences, karting tracks, and even laser tag for visitors of all ages. Another major landmark, Mall of the Emirates, is also a 15-minute drive from the community. This shopping and entertainment hub features world-class retail outlets, a vast selection of dining options, and attractions like Ski Dubai, VOX Cinemas, Yalla! Bowling, Dreamscape VR, and Magic Planet Dubai.

For those seeking waterfront leisure, Dubai Marina Walk is just 18 minutes away from Oxford Villas Dubai community. This vibrant promenade is lined with stylish restaurants, luxury spas, and recreational spots, making it an ideal destination for dining, relaxation, and entertainment. Visitors can also enjoy scenic yacht and dhow cruises or cycle along its palm tree-lined walkways, adding to the appeal of living in Oxford Villas Dubai.

Oxford Villas JVC is an excellent option for those seeking spacious and luxury villas in Dubai, offering a premium living experience with easy access to supermarkets, restaurants, parks, schools, and public transport options. The well-planned Oxford Villas Dubai lifestyle ensures convenience and comfort, making it ideal for families and professionals looking for an upscale residential community

These elegantly designed three-storey villas offer spacious 4-bedroom layouts, complete with a maid’s room and dedicated parking for two cars. The contemporary architecture and high-end finishes add to the refined appeal of the Oxford Villas Dubai community, making it an ideal choice for families seeking a sophisticated living experience.

Oxford Villas Dubai enjoys a prime location surrounded by a mix of townhouses, villas, and apartment buildings. The area offers diverse residential options, including studio to 4-bedroom apartments, as well as 3 to 5-bedroom townhouses and villas. This vibrant community is designed to foster a harmonious balance between urban convenience and suburban tranquility, making it one of the most sought-after residential addresses in JVC.

Oxford Villas Dubai lifestyle is defined by its seamless blend of serenity and accessibility. The gated environment provides a peaceful retreat while maintaining easy connectivity to major road networks, including Al Khail Road (E44), allowing quick access to key areas of Dubai.
